method: Every unique configured source ID: GET publisher URL and every configured endpoint, maximum 24 concurrent source workers, 10-second socket timeout, 5 MB per response. Optional discovery follows advertised official RSS/Atom links, one linked RSS index, and news sitemap links in robots.txt; maximum three candidates per source. No paywall or bot protection bypass. Parsed headline counts use production validation/freshness rules and are not total publisher output.
